notes: εὐαγγελιζόμενοι → preached the gospel heads on gospel, the lexeme being denominal from εὐαγγέλιον and preached the verbalizing support word; the same reading is taken at 14:15 and 14:21, and the ASV's own gloss note at 14:21 corroborates it. Heading on preached remains defensible.

The periphrastic ἦσαν is collapsed by the ASV into a simple past, so what answers to it is the subject its inflection licenses rather than nothing; 14:26 keeps the fuller had been where the periphrasis stands.
SBLGNT.ACT.14.7.v003 is underdetermined with a base reading the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
